Freespace West Kowloon Cultural District Hong Kong
EXPERIENCE A PLAYFUL AND POETIC THEATRICAL CREATION IN HONG KONG INSPIRED BY THE STORIES OF HERMÈS

Hermès invites the public to discover its story and its iconic objects in a show with surrealist touches, written by Pauline Bayle and directed by Joe Hufton. Accompanying the play, an original exhibition offers insights into the house’s spirit through a journey that combines bold staging with a new twist on oral tradition.

On set, stage props transform into ingenious tools to illustrate some of the house’s major events and surprising moments that symbolize the continuous momentum of Hermès. The diversity of the house’s sixteen métiers is showcased.

The exhibition invites the audience to wander through an installation designed like a theatre storeroom. It offers an opportunity to see these iconic objects at close quarters, to discover their history and their artisanal and creative dimensions.
The bond between past and present is felt deeply in this theatrical saga that looks firmly to the future.
